name: comp-551

frames.best_why: Six rows fill the table and the cursor is away, showing every column and row action.

tagline: Table of uploaded files with type, size and per-row actions.
summary: A files manager in table form: a count heading with Add files and Remove all, then a bordered table listing each attachment's icon and name, its type, size, and download and delete buttons.
appearance: A dark panel headed Files (6) with two small outlined buttons at the right. Below, a bordered table with a grey header row (Name, Type, Size, Actions) and six white rows where names carry a small file glyph and the last column holds two faint icons.
behaviour: Add files opens the picker and Remove all empties the table; each row's download icon opens its file while the bin drops that row. Rows tint under the pointer, and the list grows from three to six files across the frames.
demo_content: document.pdf, intro.zip, conclusion.xlsx plus cover-1/2/3.png, with type and size columns; caption links to an API doc.
search_phrases: table of uploaded files with sizes and types
file manager list with download and delete
upload documents and see their type
bulk file list with remove all
download or trash each uploaded file
use_when: Many attachments need managing after upload, with download and delete on every row.
avoid_when: The table has no sorting or row selection, so Remove all is the only batch action.
customise: The ten-file cap, the 10MB ceiling and three seed files are written in the file; the icon mapping and row actions are source edits too.
weight_why: A short table of seed files and a hidden input; no animation loop.

a11y.note: Every row action is a labelled button and the empty state offers a Select files button; the surrounding drop area is not focusable.

issues: The drop zone is hidden once files exist, so adding more by dragging stops working.
Rows omit the upload date and status the catalogue description promises.
The caption is developer copy ending in an API link.
polish_why: Tidy compact table with clear icons and row actions; developer caption and drag lost after upload.
